[[Cleansing Shadow's Passage]] | followed by = [[Cleansing Shenzun Tunnels (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:Cleansing Shadow's Passage map.jpg|250px|]] | map1text = Quest Map }} Clear [[Shadow's Passage]] of the [[Afflicted]] in [[Hard mode]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Defeat the Afflicted in Shadow's Passage. * See [[Initiate Zei Ri]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *5,000 [[Experience]] *1,000 [[Gold]] *[[Ministerial Commendation]] *Ministerial Commendation == Notes == * Completing this quest ''almost always'' results in [[vanquish]]ing the area, since the foes consist entirely of the three groups of Afflicted and one group of Jade Brotherhood (except if they happen to survive getting caught between the party and the Afflicted). ==See also== * Quest walkthrough, NPCs, and dialogue can be found on [[Cleansing Shadow's Passage]].
